source.message: The final model turn was recorded at control step 131. The remaining video frames contain no additional model turns.

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dy":-0.04},"note":"The yellow cylinder is separate from the open fingers and sits beside the circular slot. I am moving sideways to bring the gripper over the cylinder before descending."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dy":-0.06},"note":"The cylinder moved toward the middle of the wrist view after the sideways motion, confirming the direction. I will continue aligning the open fingers with it."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dy":-0.06},"note":"The yellow cylinder is still to the left of the finger gap. I am continuing the lateral approach while maintaining clearance above it."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dx":0.04,"dy":-0.05},"note":"The cylinder is near the left finger but not yet centered in depth. I am adjusting both horizontal axes to bring its upper rim into the open grasp region."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dy":-0.037,"dz":-0.045},"note":"The cylinder’s top is now visible between the fingers, slightly left of center. I will correct that offset and lower the open gripper toward its upper sides."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dz":-0.035},"note":"The cylinder is centered laterally in the open gap, and the fingers are still above its sides. I am lowering a little farther to establish a grasping height."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dx":0.055,"dz":-0.015},"note":"The cylinder is centered sideways but sits too far toward the palm in the wrist view. I am moving the fingertip contact region over it and descending slightly."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dx":0.009,"dy":0.009,"dz":-0.025},"note":"The external view now shows the fingers straddling the cylinder’s top. I am making a small centering adjustment and lowering the pads around its upper section."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"gripper":0.81},"note":"The open fingers now overlap the cylinder’s upper sides in the external view. I will close around it, then test whether it follows a lift."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dx":0},"note":"The fingers have begun closing against the cylinder but have not settled yet. I will hold the pose to let the grasp tighten before lifting."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dz":0.05},"note":"The finger opening has stabilized against the cylinder. I will lift vertically to verify that the object is securely held and clear the tabletop."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dy":0.06,"dz":0.025},"note":"The cylinder rose with the gripper, confirming a grasp. The matching hole lies to the right in the wrist view, so I will translate toward it with added clearance."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dy":0.06,"gripper":0.81},"note":"The cylinder remains elevated, but its position within the fingers has shifted slightly. I will maintain a firm closing target while continuing toward the hole."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dx":0.025,"dy":0.06,"gripper":0.81},"note":"The hole is now close to the suspended cylinder. I will move farther across and correct the depth offset so the lower end approaches the hole vertically."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dy":0.017,"dz":-0.035,"gripper":0.81},"note":"The lower end is nearly above the hole, with a small sideways offset remaining. I will correct that offset and lower partway, checking alignment before contact."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dz":-0.025,"gripper":0.81},"note":"The external view places the cylinder directly above the opening, though the wrist view still shows a depth offset. I will descend cautiously to make the remaining alignment clearer near the plate."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dx":-0.025,"dy":0.025,"gripper":0.81},"note":"At this lower height, the wrist view reveals that the opening is still ahead and to the side of the cylinder’s lower end. I will correct those offsets while keeping the tip above the plate."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dx":-0.004,"dy":0.003,"dz":-0.015,"gripper":0.81},"note":"The hole now surrounds the projected lower end, with only a small residual offset. I will make a millimeter-scale correction and begin lowering the cylinder into the opening."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dz":-0.02,"gripper":0.81},"note":"The cylinder’s lower rim appears concentric with the opening and has reached the plate. I will continue straight down slowly to seat it without changing lateral alignment."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dz":-0.02,"gripper":0.81},"note":"The visible yellow section has shortened as the cylinder entered the slot, and the gripper descended without a large pose error. I will continue the insertion another small amount."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"gripper":0},"note":"The cylinder is substantially inside the slot, and the fingers are close to the plate. I will release it in place so the gripper does not obstruct final seating."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dz":0.04,"gripper":0},"note":"The yellow top is now visible between the opening fingers and remains at the slot. I will withdraw vertically with the gripper open to check whether it is fully seated."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dz":0.025,"gripper":0.81},"note":"The cylinder stays in the opening after release, but a short section still protrudes. I will close the fingers above it, then use a gentle top-down seating check."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dz":-0.03},"note":"The closed fingertips are above the exposed yellow top. I will lower toward it in a controlled step, keeping the same horizontal alignment."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dz":-0.012},"note":"The fingertips have reached the yellow top without displacing it sideways. I will apply one small downward seating motion and check whether the object moves deeper."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dz":-0.01},"note":"The yellow top has moved slightly lower under the fingertips and remains centered in the slot. I will advance another centimeter to check the final seating depth."}

toolCalls.name: move_by
toolCalls.arguments: {"deltas":{"dz":0.05,"gripper":0},"note":"The last downward request produced no further descent, indicating the cylinder has reached a firm seated depth. I will lift the open gripper away and verify that it remains in place."}

toolCalls.name: done
toolCalls.arguments: {"summary":"The yellow object is seated in the matching slot and remains stable after releasing and withdrawing the gripper. A gentle downward check produced no further insertion.","hindsight":"The controlled end-effector frame is well above the fingertip contacts; the fingers approach the plate around eef z=0.156 m here. Release once the cylinder is guided into the slot, then check seating with closed fingertips from above. At this slot, the seated yellow top remains slightly above the plate and a top-down check stopped near eef z=0.178 m."}
